```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls()) 
```

### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r config and load data, warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

d_gps <- 
  read_csv(here(final_data,"AVENIR_grappe_gps_2023-07-31.csv")) %>%
  rename(lat = median_latitude,
         lon = median_longitude)

grappe_phase_mort <- 
  readRDS(paste0(final_data,"AVENIR_grappe_phase_2023-07-31.rds"))

# Load Niger boundaries map from Humanitarian Data Exchange
# Map downloaded from https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ner on 10 March 2026

niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin1.shp"))
niger_adm2 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin2.shp"))

```

### Collapse `grappe_phase_mort` to grappe-level outcome measures.
```{r aggregate phase specific data}

# Dropping columns on started phase and n alive since they can't be summed across phases. We also don't need them to calculate mortality rates since we have person-years.

grappe_mort <-
  grappe_phase_mort %>%
  group_by(region, district, site_code, grappe, adaptive_rand, tx) %>%
  summarise(
    # started_phase_1to59 = sum(started_phase_1to59, na.rm = T),
    pt_year_1to59 = sum(pt_year_1to59, na.rm = T),
    n_deaths_1to59 = sum(n_deaths_1to59, na.rm = T),
    # n_alive_1to59 = sum(n_alive_1to59, na.rm = T),
    lost_1to59 = sum(lost_1to59, na.rm = T),
    
    # started_phase_1to11 = sum(started_phase_1to11, na.rm = T),
    pt_year_1to11 = sum(pt_year_1to11, na.rm = T),
    n_deaths_1to11 = sum(n_deaths_1to11, na.rm = T),
    # n_alive_1to11 = sum(n_alive_1to11, na.rm = T),
    lost_1to11 = sum(lost_1to11, na.rm = T),
    
    # started_phase_12to59 = sum(started_phase_12to59, na.rm = T),
    pt_year_12to59 = sum(pt_year_12to59, na.rm = T),
    n_deaths_12to59 = sum(n_deaths_12to59, na.rm = T),
    # n_alive_12to59 = sum(n_alive_12to59, na.rm = T),
    lost_12to59 = sum(lost_12to59, na.rm = T),
    
    deaths_per_1000_1to59 = n_deaths_1to59 * 1e3 / pt_year_1to59,
    deaths_per_1000_1to11 = n_deaths_1to11 * 1e3 / pt_year_1to11,
    deaths_per_1000_12to59 = n_deaths_12to59 * 1e3 / pt_year_12to59
  )

# grappe_mort

length(unique(grappe_phase_mort$site_code))

```

### Join gps to outcome data
```{r add gps to data}
d_gps_latlon <- d_gps %>%
  dplyr::select(site_code, lat, lon, csi)

grappe_mort <- grappe_mort %>%
  left_join(d_gps_latlon, by=c("site_code")) %>%
  relocate(lat, .after=grappe) %>%
  relocate(lon, .after=grappe)

```

```{r rename districts to match shapefile district names}

grappe_mort$district[grappe_mort$district == "Tibiri (Doutchi)"] <- "Tibiri"
grappe_mort$district[grappe_mort$district == "Illela"] <- "Illéla"
```

```{r add tx labels and indicators}

# Recode tx labels to align with ms nomenclature
grappe_mort <- grappe_mort %>%
  mutate(
  tx = case_when(
    tx == "1 - Azithro 1-59m" ~ "Child Azithro",
    tx == "2 - Azithro 1-11m" ~ "Infant Azithro",
    tx == "3 - Placebo 1-59m" ~ "Placebo"),
  
  isTreated_child = case_when(
    tx == "Child Azithro" ~ "Treatment",
    .default = "Control"
    ),
  
  isTreated_alltx = case_when(
    tx == "Placebo" ~ "Control",
    .default = "Treatment"
    ),
  
  tx = factor(tx, 
              levels = c("Child Azithro","Infant Azithro","Placebo")),
  
  isTreated_child = factor(isTreated_child, 
                           levels = c("Control","Treatment")),
  
  isTreated_alltx = factor(isTreated_alltx, 
                           levels = c("Control","Treatment"))
  
  
  ) %>%
  # shorten adaptive randomization labels
  mutate(adaptive_rand = factor(adaptive_rand, 
                                levels = c("Random Allocation 1", 
                                           "Random Allocation 2", 
                                           "Random Allocation 3"),
                                labels = c("Randomization 1", 
                                           "Randomization 2", 
                                           "Randomization 3")),
         #add dummy var
         dummy = 1 
         ) %>%
  ungroup()

grappe_mort$isTreated_child <- relevel(grappe_mort$isTreated_child, ref = "Control")

grappe_mort_filt <- grappe_mort %>%
  filter(adaptive_rand %in% c("Randomization 1"))

grappe_mort_filt %>% group_by(tx,isTreated_child) %>% summarise(n=n())
# df_all %>% group_by(tx,isTreated_alltx) %>% summarise(n=n())

grappe_mort_filt %>% group_by(district,isTreated_child) %>% summarise(n=n())
# df_all %>% group_by(district,isTreated_alltx) %>% summarise(n=n())

```

```{r add district level means}

dist_mort_summ <- grappe_mort_filt %>%
  group_by(district, isTreated_child) %>%
  summarise(mean_deaths_per_1000_1to59 = mean(deaths_per_1000_1to59, na.rm=T), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = isTreated_child, 
              values_from = mean_deaths_per_1000_1to59, 
              names_prefix = "MortRate") %>%
  mutate(ATE = MortRateTreatment - MortRateControl)

```

```{r save data}

saveRDS(grappe_mort_filt, here("data", "grappe_mortality_data.rds"))
saveRDS(dist_mort_summ, here("data", "district_mortality_means.rds"))

# Save data not filtered for randomization 1 for figure 1

saveRDS(grappe_mort, here("data", "grappe_mortality_data_all_rands.rds"))

```

```{r save cropped mapping data}

districts <- unique(grappe_mort_filt$district)

crs(niger_adm2)

niger_adm2_proj <- niger_adm2 %>%
  st_transform(crs = proj_crs)

niger_adm2_sub <- niger_adm2 %>%
  filter(adm2_name %in% districts) %>%
  st_make_valid()

niger_adm2_sub_proj <- niger_adm2_sub %>%
  st_transform(crs = proj_crs)

b_boxgrid <- st_make_grid(
  niger_adm2_sub_proj,
  n = c(grid_res, grid_res),
  what = "centers",
  crs = proj_crs
) %>%
  st_sf(geometry = .) %>%
  st_filter(niger_adm2_sub_proj)

saveRDS(niger_adm2_sub, here("data", "niger_adm2_sub.rds"))
saveRDS(b_boxgrid, here("data", "boxgrid.rds"))

```
